items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The file bodies aren't in the edit log. The inline snippets do use clear names (model_id, revision, docs). But the work is split across /app/scratch/compute.py and final_check.py, both printing debug rank lists, and neither is one clear named-constant script.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Several diverging scratch scripts were left behind (/app/scratch/compute.py rewritten 3 times, plus final_check.py), along with debug output like 'Max difference between TF and ST similarities' and 30-rank dumps. /app/result.txt was written by hand instead of by the script.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The model is loaded from a hardcoded snapshot path '/root/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--BAAI--bge-small-zh-v1.5/snapshots/7999e1d...', which is fragile. No uniqueness/tie assertion. Blank lines are filtered out ('if line.strip()'), which can shift line indices.

items.name: Ranking details handled correctly
items.evidence: The final ranking used plain SentenceTransformer instead of mteb.get_model with PromptType.query/passage, so the query instruction prompt was never applied. The answer, 'HumanEval...', is wrong: the hidden test test_data_matches failed. There's also no tie check.
